Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the sales and use taxation of materials and services provided under the weatherization assistance program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the sales and use taxation of materials andservices provided under the weatherization assistance program; addinga new section to chapter 82.08 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter82.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax imposed by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales oftangible personal property or labor and services used in theweatherization of a residence under the weatherization assistanceprogram under chapter 70.164 RCW. (2) The exemption is available only when the buyer provides theseller with an exemption certificate in a form and manner prescribed bythe department. The seller must retain a copy of the certificate forthe seller's files. (3) The definitions in RCW 70.164.020 apply to this section.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply to the use oftangible personal property or labor and services used in theweatherization of a residence under the weatherization assistanceprogram under chapter 70.164 RCW. (2) The definitions in RCW 70.164.020 apply to this section.
